nom: Bubble Solar Mate Daily Mineral SPF 40

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report a matte or non-greasy finish and no added shine, though one notes getting oilier through the day in cool weather and being unsure how it performs in heat.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: some say it does not break them out and feels fine, while others report it leaves skin uncomfortably dry, tight, or leaves a heavy/greasy sensation.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (often acne-prone) skin report no breakouts, a lightweight non-heavy feel, and good performance without oiliness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including those with rosacea and perioral dermatitis, repeatedly describe it as the only sunscreen that does not irritate, burn, or break them out.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature skin reports a very matte finish that does not crease under makeup and works well on an oily T-zone.

concerns.aging: The single mention from a mature-skin reviewer focuses on matte wear under makeup rather than visible anti-aging effects.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it left their skin uncomfortably dry, tight, or dry-feeling despite marketed moisturizing claims; others with dry skin report no such issue and describe it as moisturizing.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea report it is the only sunscreen that has not caused redness, burning, or peeling, unlike other SPFs they tried.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer on prescription tretinoin and azelaic acid, and another with a niacinamide allergy, used it successfully without reported reactions.
concerns.spots: Not enough reviews specifically address hyperpigmentation or dark spots to draw a conclusion.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and call it non-comedogenic; one reviewer with hormonal, oily, acne-prone skin says she got oilier on a cool day and is unsure if she'll break out in heat.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin mostly describe it as matte, non-greasy, and shine-controlling; one exception reports increased oiliness over the course of the day.

aspects.libelle: White cast on darker skin tones
Blends in invisible on dark/brown skin

extraits.texte: I wanted to love this SPF so much as its mineral with clean ingredients. Bought for myself and my daughter. I could not figure out why I kept getting a tan/brown nose when using for a daily SPF layer under makeup. Its the product!!!! It literally does nothing for SPF protection. I mean, I would get a tan/brown nose just being outside on yard duty and I do not burn easily. Finally after using it snowboarding yesterday on a partly cloudy, overcast day and STILL getting a brow nose (after not having used this product since last summer) I'm convinced its the product. No way there is SPF in it, especially SPF 40!!!! My Olay SPF 15 will protect me all day for normal daily use. Do NOT recommend at all.
It seemed promising at first. I have brown skin, and I was able to rub in two pumps easily with no noticeable white cast. However, once I was out, it made my skin feel uncomfortably dry all day.

Definitely recommend if you have sensitive + oily skin. I struggle trying to find a good sunscreen that works with my oily skin. This sunscreen leaves my skin mate throughout the day which I love. The smell is a little disgusting though but it only smell when you first put it on.

extraits.titre: Black girls— THIS is for us!!
extraits.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin that reacts to chemical sunscreens almost immediately. This is the first mineral sunscreen that actually doesn't leave a white cast. I don't have to rub for 20 minutes or wait for the white cast to "fade". My sensitive skin also doesn't react to it.

extraits.titre: No white cast on Bengali skintone
extraits.texte: I have extremely oily/sensitive/prone to pimples skin/hormone issues. I can basically put almost nothing on my face or I'll break out. There's only one sunscreen I use but the white cast is slightly noticeable (DrJart Mineral sunscreen for oily skin people only) I was looking for another mineral sunscreen without white cast or heavy tint (will break out) and tried a few. This one has no white cast. And the formula doesn't make my skin oily (dewy) which would also break me out. I did get oilier skin throughout the day on a relatively cool day like today so not sure if I'll break out when it's hotter out. This smells like old school mineral sunscreen. The smell is fine for me. I'll be keeping this even if I break out on hot days because I can wear it on the cooler days (under 65) with a high UV index (over 3). I highly recommend this! Note for the photos, my face tone is naturally lighter than my neck like most people.

I have very acne-prone sensitive skin with type 1/2 rosacea. I also have perioral dermatitis, mostly around my lips. This is the absolute best sunscreen! The smell is definitely not the most pleasant, but it goes away when it's dried into your skin. I've tried ALL the sunscreens, ranging from the cheapest to the most expensive, including aesthetician recommendations. This is the only one I will use!

I have mature skin and this is bery matte and will not crease under my makeup. Love that it has zinc and mineral formula. Not scented. I live it on my chest and arms as well for daily use. I do have an oily t sone area. Ive used very expensive formulas that do not compare! This was my daughters and i used it one day and fell in love! I actually love most of their products!
